observations.snippet: In this work, we conduct an early exploratory study toward a better understanding of the mechanism of RAG systems, covering three code datasets, three QA datasets, and two LLMs. We focus on four design factors: retrieval document type, retrieval recall, document selection, and prompt techniques. We found that the effectiveness of prompting techniques is highly context-specific when impacting the performance of LLM-driven RAG systems, varying across different models and tasks.
